summary: Proof-worth ownership for the closed privileged-capability current/target ledger, executable Milestone 2 plane, bounded M3A/M3B fixed mandatory-video and optional-system-audio recording slices, and sovereign first-vertical-slice contract.

entries.contract: The static proof validates the exact ordered 32-row ledger against its structural JSON Schema and independent semantic validators. It closes the two ADR 0044 owner bindings; immediate socket-peer audit-token/PID-generation evidence; ancestor proc-generation, UID, stable-edge, and code-identity evidence; invocation-scoped external intent whose token remains parent-only; tokenless exact-peer finalization; prior-generation transitions across operation, stream, tap, artifact, claim-set transaction, per-resource claim, multiplex broker, host barrier, and recovery; artifact released/retained/removed and claim-set rollback/committed-handoff recovery dispositions; registry-revision-bound resource declarations; split all-or-nothing claim-set admission; multiplex broker/subscriber CAS inputs and resulting publication facts; immutable barrier snapshots across drain/recovery/reopen; four closed live transport, ordinary Canvas, status-item, and status-opened Canvas origins; generation-independent retained receipt replay with bounded eviction and expected-barrier CAS; seven mandatory tap bounds and deterministic sampling stride retained as target definitions; and current source-free tap unavailability plus producer-scoped artifact custody. It closes 19 M2 deliverables, 15 exit gates, 70 path refs, and 23 proof refs, the frozen-v0/active-v1 external-command manifest cutover, exactly one invocation-scoped listen-microphone spawn registration, v1-only Swift/help readers, canonical proof-index and workflow reachability, the fifteen-form generation-bound operation/tap/artifact/barrier grammar, authored owners 41-operation.json and 49-operation.json, and the bounded fixed mandatory-video plus optional-system-audio recording route. The proof resolves exactly 103 functional bindings and 109 functional selectors, reverse-closes six fail-closed selectors, deep-closes all 15 non-absent TypeScript/Toolkit surfaces, classifies tracked regular-file production sources and searchable privilege metadata/descriptors, binds the warm screen source to capturesAudio=false while the recording route selects same-stream system audio explicitly, binds the seven-label canvas action vocabulary without execution, and verifies the reviewed SDK snapshot without ambient SDK discovery.
entries.worth: This fails when owner, resource, recovery, barrier, dispatch, manifest, proof-index, route, package-export, current-path, or source-family truth drifts; when source-free tap or producerless artifact success appears; when fixed recording widens to microphone/followed geometry or optional system audio outruns executable multitrack proof; or when compile-only evidence is mislabeled as live/TCC acceptance.
entries.guard: Structural JSON Schema validation, independent semantic validation, authored-manifest and package-export resolution, tracked regular-file production-source discovery, reviewed SDK snapshot classification, and documentation/routing proof only; it does not run native, managed-live, daemon, browser, or TCC acceptance and performs no ./aos, build, package, install, generator, or live capability action.
